reconstruction.scope: Golden near-hemispherical ribbed dome and small open finial lantern, eighteen-window round drum with pointed surrounds, octagonal middle stage with corner pinnacles, rectangular stone shrine core and covered open colonnade with pink stone shafts/leaf capitals, turquoise/pale patterned infill as broad shared-material geometry, paved apron/retaining base and short approximate terrain-seated approaches. Gardens/major terraces/neighboring buildings remain host context. No furnished/navigable sanctuary or exact sacred calligraphy.

reconstruction.heightBasis: The inspected 2019 exterior and recent ordinary arcade photo guide a broad golden ribbed hemisphere, eighteen-window round drum, octagonal middle stage, eight pinnacles, pale carved pointed arcade and pink round shafts/leaf capitals. Picture-led height is about31m above its level platform; no surveyed height is asserted. The approximate bay rhythm uses48 round shafts plus four white corner piers; this is not a certified historic column inventory. Exact inscriptions, ornate mosaics and interior sanctuary are simplified or omitted.
reconstruction.terrainBasis: Pinned standard Protomaps2026-10-14 and Mapzen13–14 extract. Retain the original six-meter native terrain grid and water. A level shrine apron clears the sampled native grade, with a buried retaining base and short stair toward the downhill garden axis. The coarse hillside DEM does not resolve the actual terrace/threshold engineering: platform level, retaining-wall exposure and approach rise are approximate. No terrain/water cutout, garden reconstruction or bespoke topography.
